========================================
cppgorating - Third-Party Setup
========================================

IMPORTANT: Before building, you must add the required dependencies!

STEP 1: Navigate to third_party directory
cd third_party

STEP 2: Clone required repositories

# Drogon web framework (REQUIRED)
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/drogonframework/drogon.git

# Trantor network library (REQUIRED - needed by Drogon)
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/an-tao/trantor.git

# jsoncpp (REQUIRED - needed by Drogon)
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/open-source-parsers/jsoncpp.git

# libcurl (REQUIRED for /fetch endpoint)
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/curl/curl.git libcurl

# Unittest++ (REQUIRED for testing)
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/unittest-cpp/unittest-cpp.git

# Gumbo HTML parser (REQUIRED for HTML parsing)
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/google/gumbo-parser.git

STEP 3: OpenSSL Setup

Windows (vcpkg):
  vcpkg install openssl:x64-windows-static

Linux/FreeBSD:
  sudo apt-get install libssl-dev  (Ubuntu/Debian)
  sudo pkg install openssl         (FreeBSD)

STEP 4: Return to project root and build
cd ..
mkdir build && cd build
cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build . -j$(nproc)

========================================
For detailed instructions, see third_party/README.md
========================================
